title: shabbir ye sab dunya tere naam se zinda hai
body:
shabbir ye sab dunya tere naam se zinda hai
ye deen mohammad ka tere naam se zinda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ka bhi kalma tere naam se zinda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
phaili hai zamane me touheed ki tanweere'n
goonji hai tere dam se kounain ki takbeere'n
haq tujh se hai paainda,
<<DIVIDER>>
tabeere qaleel hai tu, aur faqr maseeha ka
tu waarise aadam hai , moosa ka to kya kehna
jab naam shahe bat'ha.
<<DIVIDER>>
minni ki sanad baqshi tujhe sarware aalam ne
phir ye bhi kaha mai hu shabbir tere dam se
shabbir tera nana tere naam se zinda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fitrus to farishta tha, hur ko bhi ama'n di hai
jaa'n ibne mazahir ko , aur deen ko baqshi hai
ye deene nabi haqqa,
<<DIVIDER>>
wal fajr me tu shamil, tat'heer me tu shamil
kousar ki muwaddat ki, tafseer me tu shamil
wal asr ka bhi soora ,
<<DIVIDER>>
bayyat bhi na ki tune , sar bhi na jhuka tera
zalim ko kiya ruswa sarwar ne sare naiza
quraan bhi aye aaqa,
<<DIVIDER>>
ahde nabawi alawi doure hasani ke baad
islam tane bejaa'n eksat (61) ke baad
tere naam se zinda tha tere naam se zinda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka marsia qaa'n shabbir ka shaayar bhi
pehchan yahi hai ab tere sibte jaafar ki
sad shukr tera banda,
